assets.training_provenance: Paper names PRM800K and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B. No exact training question IDs/split or train.csv available in audited assets; do not assert zero MATH test overlap.
assets.license: Bundled GTE model card states Apache 2.0. Root LICENSE returned 404; code/GRU license not confirmed. This is an unresolved provenance item, not a demand for new user permission.

new_findings: Checkpoint really expects the public 33-dimensional feature path; substituting the paper's mean-only description is dimensionally invalid.
A persistent per-request GRU state can avoid replaying all past steps. Synthetic CPU full-prefix and streaming differences were 2.384185791015625e-7; real-text/GPU equivalence remains untested.

Public incremental feature code silently repeats previous values for tokens outside raw top512; batch helper instead asserts. Such missingness must be explicit in our shadow logs, not mislabeled as fresh evidence.
GTE receives step text, not an explicit separate question input. Question effects can still be reflected indirectly in logits and text; this is not proof that the score is question-independent.

A score trained to imitate a process reward model is not a direct estimate of the benefit of allowing the next reflection. Low score could denote useful correction or hopeless wandering; high score could denote a fluent wrong step.
Old calibration max-probability logs cannot recover sampled-token ranks, top512 entropy, margins, or counterfactual next-step benefit. No actual scores were fabricated from those logs.
revised_research_question: At the SAME prefix eligible for RC14, can semantic-process information select reflection allowances that preserve correctness more efficiently than indiscriminate weakening?

annotation_contract.unit: A complete prefix and the next reflection span, associated with question hash, model, accepted token position and original controller state.
axes: prefix derivation: valid / identified error / unresolved
next span: substantive correction / redundant recheck / new useful subgoal / unproductive / unresolved
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not label correction necessary merely because it says Wait or mistake
Do not label the next step useful solely from final-answer correctness
Do not infer a counterfactual from a natural continuation
Do not treat low PRM score as a human label
annotation_contract.blinding: Review before revealing PRM score and suppression-arm outcome; retain unresolved cases and report coverage.
annotation_contract.existing_eight_cases: The earlier eight manually reviewed calibration cases only motivate this distinction; not reused as new independent validation or representative prevalence. No new question texts were reviewed in this turn.

future_causal_design_not_authorized_or_f.stage_1: Read-only shadow scoring on registered training/development trajectories. Compare original confidence/length-only information against adding semantic process score with question-disjoint validation. All features must precede the decision.
future_causal_design_not_authorized_or_f.stage_2: Matched prefix branch test: hold original R state and RNG identity fixed; allow versus suppress exactly the next eligible RC14 event, then return to identical RC14 policy. This identifies local treatment value; a held-out full rollout remains necessary for policy effects.
future_causal_design_not_authorized_or_f.controls: Fixed RC14, semantic veto, and a pre-specified matched-frequency allowance control. The latter is a diagnostic control, not a new optimized competitor. Random controls use a separate deterministic hash, never consume the generation RNG.
future_causal_design_not_authorized_or_f.stop_for_no_incremental_value: If the new score cannot distinguish substantive correction from redundant recheck beyond original confidence/length, do not run full benchmark optimization merely because the GRU interface works.
future_causal_design_not_authorized_or_f.independent_confirmation: Freeze one policy and evaluate new reconciled questions or one authorized full benchmark batch once; retain the -2pp accuracy criterion and account for all probes/caps/errors. No parameter tuning on the frozen tests.
future_causal_design_not_authorized_or_f.gpu_readiness: Not ready: real encoder/tokenizer identity, exact input-token/step alignment, data ledger and fixed replay/branch budget still needed. No GPU launch command is advertised as runnable.

runtime_contract_refinement.incomplete_feature_step: In shadow, mark invalid. Proposed future active path permanently falls back to unchanged RC14 for that request after an invalid feature, because later GRU states would otherwise inherit a fabricated history. This is our conservative design choice and must be included in coverage metrics.
runtime_contract_refinement.fixed_order: R-steered raw logits -> capture process features -> RC14 lexical penalty -> temperature/top-p/sample -> accepted-token feature update -> closed-step score; only the next eligible boundary sees the updated guard.
runtime_contract_refinement.off_path: No observer/hooks/buffers/topk with process_guard=off; do not alter shared controller or old baseline.
runtime_contract_refinement.resources: Maintain only rolling feature statistics and recurrent state instead of storing every top512 distribution; embedding input remains bounded to the audited encoder's 512-token limit. Truncation rates must be reported; no claim of negligible 1.5B overhead before measurement.
